name: pulp-ui-frames-observer
description: Pulp's pulp-ui-frames-observe: replays a fixed host frame schedule (HostFramePump timestamps, scheduled input, host parameter writes, resize, editor attach/detach) against a materialized DesignIR or a scripted UI and records every frame. Tool path and roots (checkout = the git checkout the tool was built from; build = its CMake build directory) are supplied per run; the commit is read from the checkout and the binary is content-hashed.

roots.checkout: git checkout the tools were built from
roots.build: CMake build directory of those tools

probes.name: provider
argv: grep -E '^PULP_SKIA_ICUDTL_FILE' '{root:build}/CMakeCache.txt'; grep -m2 -E 'Release|Commit' '{root:checkout}/external/skia-build/VERSION.md'; echo 'renderer: pulp::view::render_to_rgba + render_to_file ScreenshotBackend::skia (CPU raster)'; otool -L '{tool:frames}' | tail -n +2 | sed 's/ (.*//'
